why: The double corner turns half a circle (180 degrees): the top-right quarter goes to the bottom-left quarter. Turning figure 3 (top-left) half a circle gives the bottom-right quarter: option 1. Option 3 shows the bottom-left quarter, which is just copied from figure 2.
trick: A half turn sends every quarter to the diagonally opposite quarter.
note: Options 2 and 4 look the same in the scan.
